_note: Gallows Moor, level 7: the clock matters. See docs/zones.md.

gm_west.name: West Moor
gm_west.description: Bare moor, heather and wind. The Spiderwood's edge is west.

gm_mid.name: The Moor Road
gm_mid.description: A track across the moor, marked by cairns.

gm_road.name: Gallows Corner
gm_road.description: Where the moor road meets the Hollow Path. A gibbet creaks on the rise north-east.

gm_circle.name: The Stone Circle
gm_circle.description: A ring of standing stones with the Wardens' tents inside it. Their fire is sheltered by the stones.

gm_stone_1.name: The Leaning Stone
gm_stone_1.description: A single standing stone, leaning into the wind. It hums.

features.stone: Holes bored through it. When the wind blows, it sings.

gm_stone_2.name: The Tall Stone
gm_stone_2.description: The tallest stone on the moor, alone on the ridge.

features.stone: Carved with spirals. Wind moans through a hole near the top.

gm_stone_3.name: The Split Stone
gm_stone_3.description: A stone split by lightning, both halves still standing.

features.stone: The wind whistles in the split.

gm_gibbet.name: The Gibbet
gm_gibbet.description: A gibbet on the rise, an old lantern hanging from it. Hoofprints burned into the turf all round.

gm_hide.name: The Hide Path
gm_hide.description: A path into a stand of twisted thorn trees. Fresh horse dung.

gm_hide_in.name: Crowe's Hide
gm_hide_in.description: A hideout in the thorns: a fire, stolen saddles, and Captain Crowe.

riders_lantern_item.name: Rider's lantern
riders_lantern_item.description: An iron lantern with no candle, still warm.

ysolde.name: Warden Ysolde
ysolde.label: Warden
ysolde.description: tall and windburned, with a longbow
ysolde.details: Tall and windburned, with a longbow.

topics.work: Three things. Ask me about the stones, the highwaymen, or the Rider.

stones.text: The standing stones sing when the wind is up, and the song tells us the weather to come. Stand at all three while the wind blows, and tell me what you hear.

highwaymen.text: Five of Crowe's highwaymen, and Crowe himself, in his hide past the gibbet. His pistol: dodge it.

rider.text: The Hollow Rider. He rides from dusk to dawn, and nothing we have stops him. His lantern hangs on the gibbet by day. Steal it, by day, and he can't find his way.

riders_lantern.description: The Hollow Rider's lantern, burning now with an ordinary flame. +1 Presence: people step back from it.

one.goal: Stand at the Leaning Stone (north-west of the circle) while the wind is up.

effects.text: The stone moans a long low note. Rain, it says, from the west.

two.goal: Now the Tall Stone, on the ridge, in the wind.

effects.text: A high, thin whistle. Cold coming.

three.goal: And the Split Stone, in the wind.

effects.text: Two notes at once. A storm, and after it, stillness.

back.goal: Tell Ysolde what you heard: ASK YSOLDE ABOUT STONES.

reputation.note: You listened to the stones for the Wardens.

band.goal: Kill five highwaymen on the moor.

crowe.goal: Now Captain Crowe, in his hide past the gibbet.

back.goal: Tell Ysolde: ASK YSOLDE ABOUT HIGHWAYMEN.

get.goal: By day, while the Rider is gone, take the lantern from the gibbet: GET LANTERN.

back.goal: Bring it to Ysolde: USE LANTERN ON YSOLDE.

effects.text: Ysolde lights it with an ordinary match, and the flame comes up ordinary and yellow. "Keep it. He'll be riding in circles now."
